verdict.rationale: Greptile is documented as reviewing every PR with full codebase context. Its v5 agent swarm is claimed to catch more bugs with fewer false positives, and TREX runs the PR branch in a sandbox to find bugs that only show up at runtime. Strictness and noise-control settings, plus feedback training, suppress low-impact nits, and an independent user reports it 'more often than not catches real issues', though it is sometimes overzealous. Missing for 10: specific evidence of catching logic errors, race conditions or broken edge cases; independent benchmarks of bug-catch rate or false positives.
